notes.title: FSOG 3 Valentine's Update is here!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Happy Valentine's Day to you all! Let the loved ones of yours know how much you love them tonight. And we've prepared decent discounts for you to help in this case! [b]Grab Furry Shades Of Gay 3 with a nice [b]discount of 30%[/b] now and pick up other games in the series with a discount of 50%![/b]

Now, let's celebrate together with a new story, shall we?

[h2]Evan and Master are back![/h2] 

This Valentine’s Day is special for Evan. Him and his Master have been together for quite a while, and he’s excited to spend this special day together. He's a little nervous though? What are they to each other? Friends with benefits or something more? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/86db977214ff80abd5d094b18018b51fd29c23df.png[/img]

You can tell he's not the only one having a crisis there - his Master is clearly trying to tell Evan something important. Will they get distracted during their happy little dinner with all the gear in Master's house, or will their choice be a little more romantic this time? 

Find out in the story! There are more secrets to this couple than you think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/d7f2fdb6f4f4bf06016e693127a9802a88d3c704.png[/img]

Wishlist our new game, if you're into girls as well:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

notes.title: FURRY SHADES OF GAY 3 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello there, friends! 

[h2][b]IT'S HERE![/b][/h2]

Go grab yourself a copy of  Furry Shades Of Gay 3, because it's out [b]NOW[/b]! I'm so glad I don't have to keep these stories all to myself anymore! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/c0e0316e1ff843916024e5aec9053d97dbfdffd7.png[/img]

[h2]5 NEW STORIES![/h2]

It's finally time to welcome our new boys in the family, as well as say hi to your deeply loved couple! Find lots of new ways to entertain a smoking hot boy at work and pick the boss' attention, visit Italian winery with a chance of getting something more than just photos, take care of the back pain (hot masseur included!), choose a love nest with your all-time favorites and spend the last summer day and night in the scout camp. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/1ecda79dfc0a41c1c60efb68fac77acf19113ccd.png[/img]

[h2]THE LOVE POTION OF STORIES AND PUZZLES![/h2]
 
Third time is the charm - hotter, bigger, louder! The stories are now partially voiced, they have become longer and funnier to explore. And the cherry on top - drop dead hot animations of all the hot boys making love! What more to wish for? There's nothing like a good old challenge of Match-3 - we took all the best from the previous games and made it better for you! Solve the puzzles and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/18b6c7abf4741dd9cdeec33f786eb2b24d42d22b.png[/img]

[h2]SO WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?[/h2]

No matter if you're an old fan or just got here - we've got everything you need to start and continue your journey into the sweet paradise of love, lust and hottest boys in the area! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259608/ecb923c4819fbd79db5f0bbd1c99c3dc309fcefd.png[/img]

We're so happy to finally bring you our new game, it's such a pleasure to see you all gather for our releases, we appreciate your support and endless love. Each of us worked hard for this one, and I'm sure you'll like Furry Shades Of Gay 3 as much, as previous parts. 

Okay, it's time to go and play, enjoy the game and don't forget, that we're always open for the feedback! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953540/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_3_Still_Gayer/

Can't wait to see what you think of the new boys and new stories. 

Join us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/furlough_games]https://twitter.com/furlough_games[/url]
Hang out with us on Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR]https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR[/url]

notes.title: PUZZLE FEST AND DISCOUNTS!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

Long time no see. But here we are with some big news for you! 

[h2]PUZZLE FEST![/h2]
That's right! We're taking part in the Puzzle Fest starting today, April, 24th - don't miss out on the opportunity to fiddle with our match-3 games full of joy and love! To celebrate this festival we've set up a discount of 50% off! 

On to the next topic! 

[h2]THE GRAND UPDATE IS COMING![/h2]
This summer all our players will get a surprise. Now that I've said that in the subtitle, it's no longer a surprise. But hear me out: Furry Shades Of Gay will get the sound work on sex scenes, updated animations and graphics and even more little changes here and there, so there's even more opportunities to freshen up your memories by playing the game after the update!

[h2]CHANGING THE COST[/h2]
Time goes by, we evolve and we need our price tag to evolve, too. 

After Puzzle Fest discounts are gone, Furry Shades Of Gay will raise in price a little so that we can continue making new games and update older ones for you for free! 

So, if you have ever considered picking up a copy of any of our games, now is the [b]perfect[/b] time to do so.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/0ed99d11416a5771c01928cee70697763f16a67d.png[/img]

Thanks for staying with us on our journey! Don't forget to check out our social media for more fun stuff!

notes.title: BONUS ART UPDATE AND ART PACK DLC
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

As the fall is here, it’s time to shake things up a little, right? That’s why we’re here to announce a bonus art update! We’re also pleased to say that DLC for Furry Shades of Gay is now up! Let’s dive deep into the news, shall we?
 

[h1]Bonus art update![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/c99a3e310b0dc3365069b73258134e69b919caf1.png[/img]
Nice and spicy, the new update brings you additional art which you can open completing the challenge after fully finishing the stories! More hot art of your favorite heroes from our beloved artists, isn’t it exciting?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/6f8d39bd4d97aeb1c8e24ae262d7c4493d78d1ff.png[/img]

After you clear any scenario and unlock story mode, two new plaques will appear (most are in the top left of the tree). Click on the left one, complete the challenge, and the bonus artwork will unlock!
 

[h1]DLC is up![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/07516ab20889ef1472cc51c71433e7ac33b11dd0.png[/img]
With this DLC bundle you’ll get access to high resolution artworks, sketches and more! Devil is in the details, and this one is pretty sexy and gay, so take a closer look to your favorite heroes! We’ve also included sketches, extra materials, and some pre-production style tryouts for your viewing pleasure.

After you purchase the DLC and the download finishes, right click on the game’s card or list entry, select Manage > Browse local files, and you’ll find all the artworks in the folder called “Art Pack”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/65f4093c73f637da5f9728b5d4865463bd48c6b1.png[/img]

And don’t forget, most of our profits go directly to the budgets for our future games! So if you want to see bigger and better stories, and more of them, please consider supporting us by purchasing this DLC!
 

[h1]Little reminder[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/9ca20486099e431467e4d1cf8c8f1a3fc187ef1e.png[/img]
Thank you for your endless support, it helps us bring you more games with fantastic art, and improve the overall experience!

Don’t forget to add Furry Shades of Gay 2: a Shade Gayer to your wishlist, it’s going to be an awesome adventure, we promise!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1724050/Furry_Shades_of_Gay_2_A_Shade_Gayer__Love_Stories_Episodes/

The store page for Sex and the Furry Titty 2 is also up, and the game itself is scheduled for Spring 2022. If you are interested in ladies as well, don’t hesitate to wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1750200/Sex_and_the_Furry_Titty_2_Sins_of_the_City__Love_Stories_Episodes/

Follow our Twitter for more exclusive content and fun!
https://twitter.com/furlough_games

Join our Discord server to make new friends, share your experience and fan arts with us!
https://discord.com/invite/PZJfRpRRqR

Hugs and kisses,
Furlough Games Team

- Felix

Our lead developer spent a fair few days on making it work, but it should be all good now. As soon as you unlock all the chapters in the story, a checkbox will appear, letting you turn on the Story Mode.
When the Story Mode is on, you won’t have to play through the match-3 challenges. Just choose the path you want and enjoy the ride!

notes.content:
Good news, everyone! We now have animated stickers in the Points Shop! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/bc9de348565c4d96b35eafb7a14efef898683ece.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/4223500068319610e574d9005ad98fc6e24872cc.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/b1a0e420f75a57de831c4b1279087434d959c86d.gif[/img]

Aren’t they awesome? If you want to grab one, just go to our points shop page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1399930/cluster/5]https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1399930/cluster/5[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/ebc31af9a6a1bba25c9cc6bfe4c93d3a2331b04e.png[/img]

It’s a silly thing, but we had a lot of fun coming up with the stickers and making them, and it didn’t take too much development time. Honest!


Oh, and another thing happened. We’ve been talking about our experience making a game in our friend group recently, and some of them decided to have a go at it, too. And we agreed to help our friends with the publishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/b0ebf01ea16e46424f51cc0eb9400ee03abfd54d.png[/img]

In return they stole our UI and poached one of our contractors. And it’s going to be a collection of minigames with some licensed art. Yeah, we should probably stop being friends with them.

But hey, if you like to _earn_ your art, it should be pretty decent. And they are going to add some original animations, too, so even if you are an experienced yiffynnoisseur, there will be something new to see. So maybe check out  their game page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1567080

But back to our Shades. Our lead developer finally had some free time and was able to do a thing.

He should be able to finally add the achievements pretty soon, too. And once it’s all in there, we’ll release the update. So please keep an eye out for further announcements.

With love,
- Felix

notes.title: First major update, future plans, and the future of Furlough Games
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

Our first semi-major update to the game went live. It brings a new pattern match and a new bonus item. It goes boom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/caa1ac62291aaef3285fc5008d8a6b462f17dbf9.png[/img]

Just match items in T- or L-pattern, and you'll get a "bomb" bonus item. Match this one, and it will obliterate all the items around it.

Almost all the challenge levels were also rebalanced, it should be much easier to clear out the stories now. 

We’ve also had a couple of awesome people reach out to us about the help with the localization, and we’ve already included some improved scripts and UI localization changes.

There are also a number of bugfixes related to the challenge level freezes and script mix-ups.

[h1]Upcoming goodies[/h1]
Right now we’re working on implementing the “story mode” and achievements. We also got green light on adding trading cards and community items to the game, so expect the first set soon!

And we are working on a FREE bonus story, coming this February. Don’t want to spoil it too much, so will only share a couple of storyboard clippings for now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39113250/bb948da73c33fd63b67c291e036dc206fec37050.png[/img]
We hope you’ll like it!


[h1]Future of Furlough Games[/h1]
And now to some less cheery news. First of all, we are incredibly grateful for all the great reception the game got, and we are super happy that so many people found it fun.

Alas, our sales still fell short of the amount that was required to keep the whole studio working full-time. So, keeping true to our name, we are downsizing, at least for a time. Our lead developer is going to return to the contract work, and the rest of us will pick up some side gigs as well.

That said, we have no plans to give up just yet. The artists all got paid in full, so we are starting work on another game. It won’t be a sequel, more of a sidequel. Same genre, but targeting a different niche, one with a more mass-market appeal. If we can make this work, we will try to alternate between niches, and if at all possible, explore even more underserved ones in the future. 

Official announcement will come soon enough, once we have some art to share, so stay tuned!

[h3]With love,
- Felix Vine[/h3]
